---
title: "MiTeX"
format: typst
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    mitex: true
---

## LaTeX maths to Typst via MiTeX

This filter converts LaTeX maths to Typst using the MiTeX package.
Inline maths becomes `#mi(...)` and display maths becomes `#mimath(...)`.
The `#import "@preview/mitex:0.2.6": *` statement is injected once in the header.

### Inline maths

The famous equation $E = mc^2$ is converted to a MiTeX inline call.

### Display maths

$$
\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx = F(1) - F(0)
$$
